name: talesauce
description: An 8-bit, Stardew-Valley-style world where AI agents are pixel-art characters that walk to their desks, do real work, and report back. Server-authoritative, fully procedural, TypeScript monorepo.

scripts.build: npm -w @talesauce/shared run build && npm -w @talesauce/server run build && npm -w @talesauce/web run build
